records.build: Modwerk's linker: the plain Rytm base (core-ar2 0.7) + this folder's Improved Performance 0.1.0-experimental compiled with -DCW_NEAR_MEAN=1 (the mark's threshold lowered so that it shows in the emulator, where the audio load stays low; nothing else differs from the release build), materialised against stock OS 1.74, --version IPCN

emulator.name: rytm-emu
emulator.settings: no card image (the card starts formatted); JIT on; --every 1000M

records.conditions: Cold boot; four NO presses clear the notices; the main screen after 7,700 M instructions. The word CPU at the right end of the bottom bar: the warning.

captures.plan: DTBOOT_END_PNG=cpu-near.png dtboot ipcn.syx --instr 7700M --every 1000M --press NO@4503M:80M --press NO@5303M:80M --press NO@6103M:80M --press NO@6903M:80M
